findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_horoscope, get_horoscope_period · Private data: get_compatibility · Public sink: get_horoscope, open_chart_studio, get_life_milestones, find_chart_twins, get_birthday, get_horoscope_period · Destructive: get_sky, check_sky_fact, get_birthday, get_natal_chart, get_chinese_zodiac, find_birthplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_horoscope, get_horoscope_period · Private data: get_compatibility · Public sink: get_horoscope, open_chart_studio, get_life_milestones, find_chart_twins, get_birthday, get_horoscope_period · Destructive: get_sky, check_sky_fact, get_birthday, get_natal_chart, get_chinese_zodiac, find_birthplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
